'''Clan Freetaa''' or '''House Freetaa''' was a famous [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Among its members was the late [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. "Freetaa" meant "brave" in [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]].
